name: AR_MEMO_LINES_ALL_B
description: The AR_MEMO_LINES_ALL_B table stores information about standard memo lines for debit memos, on-account credits, debit memo reversals, chargebacks, and invoices. If AutoAccounting is based on standard line items, Oracle Receivables uses this table to obtain the revenue account.  . This table also stores the tax code, unit standard price, unit of measure, and standard invoicing and accounting rules for each standard memo line. . The primary key for this table is MEMO_LINE_ID.
